title: Catchplate Response v2 State Authority RPC

readinessArtifactSha256.$comment: The verifier MUST reconstruct the nested readiness payload and require exact equality with serviceRole, processId, roleId, executable, configuration, operation-set, logical-subkey-set, and provider generation bindings.

receiptArtifactSha256.$comment: The verifier MUST reconstruct the signed reconciliation payload and require its domain, authoritative cursor, state, and result digest to equal this receipt.

exactRoleReadinessArtifacts.$comment: The state authority verifies this deterministic seven-role order against the installed provider generation and rejects duplicate service roles, role IDs, process IDs, keys, signatures, or artifact digests.

oneOf.$comment: RETRIEVE is a read-only lookup against a durable PREPARE result. It MUST NOT advance the attempt revision or perform a second release CAS.
